--- words of two applications
on t()
    tell application "Finder"
        set a to name of Finder window 1
        tell application "System Events"
            set b to name of first process whose frontmost is true
            set c to home directory of current user
        end tell
        set d to name of home
    end tell
    return {a, b, c, d}
end t
--- tell me keeps the words
on t()
    tell application "Finder"
        tell me
            set a to Finder window 1
            set b to home
        end tell
        tell current application
            set c to home directory of (system info)
        end tell
    end tell
    return {a, b, c}
end t
--- tell an object keeps the words
on t(x)
    tell application "System Events"
        tell process "Finder"
            tell x
                set a to name of every UI element
            end tell
            set b to value of attribute "AXFocused" of window 1
        end tell
    end tell
    return {a, b}
end t
--- raw codes where the words are not known
on t(x)
    set a to «class brow» 1 of x
    set b to «constant ****icnv»
    tell application "System Events"
        set c to «class brow» 1 of x
        set d to «class prcs» 1
    end tell
    tell application x
        set e to «class sdsk»
    end tell
    return {a, b, c, d, e}
end t
--- commands of another application
on t(x)
    tell application "Finder"
        «event prcsclic» x
        update x
    end tell
    tell x
        «event fndrfupd» 1
        display dialog "a"
    end tell
end t
--- tell by identifier
on t()
    tell application id "com.apple.finder"
        set a to name of Finder window 1
        set b to home
    end tell
    tell application "/System/Library/CoreServices/Finder.app"
        set c to startup disk
    end tell
    return {a, b, c, name of application id "com.apple.finder"}
end t
--- properties inside and outside a tell block
on t(x)
    tell application "Safari" to set a to properties of window 1
    tell application "System Events" to set b to properties of x
    set c to properties of x
    set d to «class pALL» of x
    tell application x
        set e to «class pALL» of x
        set f to class of item 1 of x
    end tell
    return {a, b, c, d, e, f}
end t
--- an application with script suites
on t()
    tell application "TextEdit"
        set a to name of document 1
        set b to paragraph 2 of text of document 1
        set c to size of attribute run 1 of text of document 1
        set d to properties of window 1
        print document 1 with properties {copies:2, collating:true} without print dialog
        make new document with properties {text:"a"}
        return {a, b, c, d, color of word 1 of text of document 1, path of document 1}
    end tell
end t
--- a class that is its own plural
on t(x)
    set a to text of x
    set b to {styled text of x, Unicode text of x, strings of x}
    set c to (text of x) as list
    set d to count of text of x
    repeat with i in text of x
        set e to i
    end repeat
    tell application "TextEdit"
        set f to text of document 1
        set g to every text
        set h to text of documents whose name is "a"
    end tell
    tell application "Mail" to set j to {rich text of x, paragraphs of rich text of x}
    tell x to set k to every text
    return {a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, j, k}
end t
--- the property with the code of a class that is its own plural
on t(x)
    return {«property ctxt» of x, «property ctxt», text of x}
end t
--- use application
use application "Finder"
on t()
    set a to name of Finder window 1
    set b to home
    update b
    tell application "Safari"
        set c to URL of document 1
        set d to startup disk
    end tell
    tell current application
        set e to name of home
    end tell
    return {a, b, c, d, e}
end t
--- use two applications
use application "System Events"
use application id "com.apple.finder"
on t(x)
    set a to name of UI element 1
    set b to home directory
    set c to name of Finder window 1
    set d to «class cfol» 1 of x
    tell application "Finder" to set e to folder 1
    return {a, b, c, d, e}
end t
--- use lines without scripting additions
use AppleScript version "2.4"
use framework "Foundation"
on t(x)
    set a to «event sysoexec» "ls" with «class badm»
    «event sysodlog» "a" given «class btns»:{"x"}
    set b to POSIX file of x
    tell application "Finder" to set c to «event sysoexec» (name of home)
    return {a, b, c}
end t
--- use lines with scripting additions
use framework "Foundation"
use scripting additions
on t(x)
    set a to do shell script "ls" with administrator privileges
    display dialog "a" buttons {"x"}
    return a
end t
